_comment: Pinned fosrl/newt release (Pangolin's tunnel client, CUR-1266). Bump deliberately, same way llama_version.json is bumped. sha256s computed by us at pin time -- newt's GitHub releases publish no checksums file. UNLIKE llama.cpp, these assets are single raw binaries, not tar.gz/zip archives -- no extraction step, just download + verify + chmod +x. linux-x64/linux-arm64 and macos-arm64/macos-x64 checksums have been downloaded and verified (the macOS pair on a real Apple-silicon Mac, macOS 27, and cross-checked against the digests GitHub publishes for the 1.18.1 assets; newt_darwin_arm64 also run and paired end to end there); the windows entry is the real published filename/URL but its sha256 is a placeholder that MUST be verified (download once, compute sha256, replace) before relying on it -- see aipotluck/installer/newt_fetch.py's own warning on an unverified entry.
